remaining_limits: Static review certifies the bounded exporter design and current frozen bytes, not the future Git responses or semantic correctness of a recovered declaration route.
Git cat-file --batch responses are associated with the two requested paths by fixed request/response order; the retrieved blob identity is checked independently from its bytes.
A missing response is a result for one exact historical path; it neither triggers fallback nor proves actual compiler include resolution failure.

Top-level Makefile variables and the public wrapper may support a conditional source-text route only; actual flags, selected configuration, preprocessor selection, type widths, packing and runtime behavior remain separate evidence obligations.
A malformed response can leave a preceding saved file; raw streams and failure record are preserved, execution stops and no automatic retry or substitute retrieval is authorized.
An unexpected non-blob Git object or batch error is a stopped retrieval failure, not a negative source finding.
